categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen JT Automation Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the specialized equipment manufacturing industry, focusing on the research, development, production, sales, and service of electronic assembly equipment. Its main product lines include electronic thermal equipment (such as reflow soldering and wave soldering machines), inspection equipment (AOI and SPI), automation equipment, optoelectronic display equipment, and semiconductor specialized equipment. The company serves the electronic manufacturing industry, providing integrated zero-defect soldering and inspection manufacturing systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies in temperature control, heat transfer, motion control, and machine vision for its products. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including flexible small-batch production, digital modeling, AI deep learning algorithms for intelligent inspection, and digitalized smart direct current reflow soldering technology. The production process integrates engineering expertise with SAP data systems for lean manufacturing and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: JT Automation serves electronic manufacturing enterprises producing PCBA lines, with end markets spanning consumer electronics, communication electronics, automotive electronics, home appliances, aerospace electronics, and robotics components. Its customers include large manufacturing enterprises, well-known brand manufacturers, and listed companies in these sectors. The company has a strong domestic customer base and is expanding its international sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with domestic sales accounting for approximately 88.54% of revenue. It has established subsidiaries and branches in Shenzhen, Hangzhou, Shanghai, Suzhou, and overseas entities in Hong Kong, Malaysia, and the Cayman Islands. International sales accounted for about 11.46% of revenue, with plans to expand global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: JT Automation operates in the midstream segment of the electronic manufacturing supply chain, producing specialized equipment used in the assembly and inspection of electronic components and PCBs. It supplies critical manufacturing equipment to downstream electronic product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes autonomous innovation with a focus on AI and digital economy technologies, aiming to develop high-precision, intelligent, and energy-efficient electronic thermal equipment. Key R&D projects include AI-enabled direct current reflow soldering, electromagnetic pump control, energy-saving nitrogen technology, and integrated inspection systems. It collaborates with leading research institutions and core customers to maintain technological leadership and expand into high-end application fields such as automotive electronics, new energy, and aerospace.
categories.revenue_model: JT Automation generates revenue primarily through direct sales of specialized equipment and related services. The sales model is predominantly order-based with direct sales accounting for about 89.09% of revenue, supplemented by agency sales. Revenue recognition occurs upon customer acceptance and product delivery, with domestic sales dominating and growing international sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in the electronic thermal equipment sector, recognized as a national manufacturing champion product holder. It holds a strong market position in China with growing global ambitions. The industry is competitive with both domestic and international players, but JT Automation leverages its technological advantages, brand reputation, and customer relationships to maintain leadership and pursue market share expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 728.75 million, a 1.19% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 83.17 million, representing a 110.98% increase. The company maintains a stable gross margin around 34.92% and has a solid asset base with total assets of about RMB 1.16 billion. It demonstrates steady growth with increasing profitability and strong cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JT Automation emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced, and intelligent electronic assembly equipment that supports zero-defect manufacturing. Its products feature core proprietary technologies in thermal control and machine vision, combined with AI and digital innovations to enhance efficiency, reliability, and energy savings. The company offers customized, integrated solutions with strong after-sales service, fostering long-term customer partnerships and competitive differentiation through innovation and domestic substitution of imported equipment.
